Body.Content:
What and Why:

We are announcing the General Availability (GA) of developer mode and the Power BI Project (PBIP) file format in Power BI Desktop.

PBIP is the code-based format for Power BI development and includes:

  • Power BI Report (PBIR) for report definitions
  • Tabular Model Definition Language (TMDL) for semantic models

This update expands support for source control, CI/CD workflows, and programmatic development scenarios outside of Power BI authoring tools.

As part of GA, PBIR becomes the default report format across Power BI Desktop and the Power BI service. PBIR-Legacy remains supported; however, reports edited in Power BI tools will automatically be upgraded to PBIR.

Note: PBIR is not replacing PBIX. PBIX remains the primary file format for Power BI developers. Internally, PBIX files will now store report metadata using PBIR instead of PBIR-Legacy.

For more information, see: Power BI Desktop projects (PBIP) - Power BI | Microsoft Learn.

Rollout Schedule:

  • Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, DoD: Mid-September 2026 through late September 2026

Who is affected

  • Power BI developers using the PBIP file format
  • Organizations leveraging source control, DevOps, or CI/CD processes for Power BI development
  • Power BI Desktop and Power BI service environments

Platforms/Services

  • Power BI Desktop
  • Power BI service
  • Power BI Project (PBIP)
  • Power BI Report (PBIR)

What will happen

  • PBIR becomes the default report format for Power BI reports.
  • Reports currently using PBIR-Legacy will automatically convert to PBIR when edited in Power BI tools.
  • Existing PBIX workflows remain supported and unchanged.
  • Report functionality and end-user experiences are unaffected.
  • Report consumers will not see any changes to report behavior or functionality.
  • The tenant setting "Automatically convert and store reports using Power BI enhanced metadata format (PBIR)" will be removed because PBIR will no longer be an opt-in experience.

Action Required / Recommendations:

No action is required.

We recommend that Power BI administrators:

  • Review internal documentation that references PBIR-Legacy or report metadata formats.
  • Update governance, development, and CI/CD guidance to reflect PBIR as the default format.
  • Communicate this change to Power BI developers and development teams as appropriate.

Additional Information

For more information, review the Power BI Desktop projects (PBIP) documentation on Microsoft Learn.

Details.Value: Power BI developer mode and the PBIP file format are generally available, making PBIR the default report format in Power BI Desktop and service. This enhances source control, CI/CD, and programmatic development. PBIX remains primary, with no impact on report functionality. No user action is required.

Title: General Availability of Power BI developer mode
